abstract: We link two global trends—AI and geoeconomic fragmentation—asking how fragmentation affects the international diffusion of AI, the magnitude of gains, and their distribution across economies. We ask these questions in general but also with a focus on the MENAP economies.
abstract_zh: 我们将两大全球趋势——人工智能与地缘经济碎片化——联系起来，探讨碎片化如何影响人工智能的国际扩散、收益规模及其在各经济体间的分布。我们不仅从一般层面提出这些问题，还特别聚焦于中东、北非及巴基斯坦（MENAP）经济体。
china_relevance_reason: 研究聚焦AI与地缘经济碎片化对全球及中东北非经济体的影响，未涉及中国数据、制度或政策背景，作者姓名不足以判定为中国研究。
title: AI in a Fragmenting World

abstract: This paper studies how an unemployment-benefit reform in one member state of a monetary union affects savings, net foreign asset positions, and fiscal space across member states when households face incomplete insurance. Lower benefits reduce unemployment and increase fiscal space in the reforming country. Employed workers increase their precautionary savings to compensate for reduced public insurance. A portion of these savings is invested abroad, pushing the non-reforming country into a negative net foreign asset position and lowering its long-run consumption. Despite raising fiscal space and long-run average consumption in the reforming country, the reform may decrease ex-ante welfare because it reduces insurance and depresses consumption during the transition as households self-insure through higher savings. We discipline our proposed model with firm-level evidence on Germany’s post-reform tradable-sector expansion following the Hartz IV reform of unemployment benefits. In our simulation, this reform accounts for a substantial share of the observed post-reform open-economy adjustment, whereas the earlier wage moderation cannot explain most of the observed patterns.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在一个货币联盟中，某一成员国的失业救济改革如何影响各成员国的储蓄、净外国资产头寸及财政空间，前提是家庭面临不完全保险。降低救济金减少了改革国的失业并扩大了其财政空间。就业工人增加预防性储蓄以弥补公共保险的减少。这部分储蓄的一部分投资于国外，使非改革国陷入负净外国资产头寸，并降低其长期消费。尽管改革提高了改革国的财政空间和长期平均消费，但由于减少了保险并在转型期间因家庭通过更高储蓄进行自我保险而抑制了消费，改革可能降低事前福利。我们利用德国哈茨四号失业救济改革后贸易部门扩张的企业层面证据来校准所提出的模型。在我们的模拟中，这项改革解释了观察到的改革后开放经济调整的相当大份额，而早前的工资节制则无法解释大部分观察到的模式。
title: Incomplete Insurance and Open-Economy Spillovers of Labor Market Reforms
title_zh: DP21866 不完全保险与劳动力市场改革的开放经济溢出效应

abstract: The choice of a major in higher education is closely associated with the sector of activity of future employment. As a labour price signal, the industry salary level is transmitted to candidates through the labour market and affects their choice of major. Drawing on panel data matching college entrance examination admission scores of majors with industry salary levels from 147 Chinese ‘Double First-Class’ universities during 2019–2023, this study employs fixed-effects panel regression models to explore the mechanism underlying the effect of industry salary levels on college entrance examination admission scores for corresponding majors. The findings indicate that rising industry salary levels significantly increase the college entrance examination admission scores of relevant majors, and that the rising popularity of majors and the improvement in teaching quality are important factors contributing to these higher admission scores. More importantly, the increasing salary levels of upstream industries also contribute to higher college entrance examination admission scores for majors related to the target industry. From the perspective of salary signals, this article provides empirical evidence regarding the major choices of college entrance examination candidates, the structure of university majors, and the improvement of the talent supply–demand matching mechanism. KEYWORDS: Industry salary level price signal college entrance examination score for majors Double First-Class universities JEL CLASSIFICATION: J31 J24 I21
abstract_zh: 高等教育专业选择与未来就业的行业领域密切相关。作为劳动力价格信号，行业薪酬水平通过劳动力市场传递给考生，并影响其专业选择。本研究利用2019—2023年间147所中国“双一流”高校的专业高考录取分数与行业薪酬水平相匹配的面板数据，采用固定效应面板回归模型，探讨行业薪酬水平对相应专业高考录取分数的影响机制。研究结果表明，行业薪酬水平的上升显著提高了相关专业的高考录取分数，而专业热度的上升及教学质量的提升是推动录取分数提高的重要因素。更为重要的是，上游行业薪酬水平的提升同样有助于提高目标行业相关专业的高考录取分数。本文从薪酬信号视角，为高考考生的专业选择、高校专业结构设置及人才供需匹配机制的完善提供了经验证据。关键词：行业薪酬水平；价格信号；专业高考录取分数；双一流高校 JEL分类：J31 J24 I21
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Industry salary signals and adjustments in college entrance examination admission scores for majors: evidence from China’s Double First-Class universities
title_zh: 行业薪酬信号与高考专业录取分数线的调整：来自中国“双一流”大学的证据

abstract: This study examines the impact of smartphone adoption on livestock trading in pastoral China. We develop a bargaining and search model with two mechanisms: information discovery, which reduces herders’ search costs, and information posting, which expands market access. Using household survey data, we find that smartphone adoption increases selling prices. Mechanism analysis shows that traditional phone functions improve information access, while smartphone-specific features, especially information posting, enhance bargaining power by expanding selling channels and trader access. These findings demonstrate that digital technologies affect market outcomes not only through improved information access but also by reshaping bargaining structures and market participation.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了智能手机采用对中国牧区牲畜交易的影响。我们构建了一个包含两种机制的议价与搜索模型：信息发现机制，降低了牧民的搜索成本；信息发布机制，扩大了市场准入。利用家户调查数据，我们发现智能手机的采用提高了销售价格。机制分析表明，传统电话功能改善了信息获取，而智能手机特有功能，尤其是信息发布，通过拓宽销售渠道和增加交易商接触，增强了议价能力。这些发现表明，数字技术不仅通过改善信息获取，还通过重塑议价结构和市场参与，影响市场结果。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Smartphones, information, and bargaining power: Evidence from pastoral areas in China
title_zh: 智能手机、信息与议价能力：来自中国牧区的证据

abstract: Can localized weather shocks to upstream fuel suppliers undermine down-stream electricity reliability? Using administrative data linking South African power plants to contracted coal mines from 2015 to 2024, we combine plant operating records, mining-firm revenue data, and route-level traffic sensor data. Exploiting within-plant variation in supplier-mine rainfall, we find that rainfall shocks reduce mine output and lower coal plant availability. Daily traffic data confirm that rainfall reduces coal deliveries along contracted mine-to-plant routes. These disruptions propagate to the grid, contributing to rolling blackouts. Electricity security hinges on the resilience of coal supplyn contracts and logistics, not only on plant resilience.
abstract_zh: 局部天气冲击是否会通过上游燃料供应商传导至下游电力可靠性？利用2015至2024年间连接南非电厂与签约煤矿的行政数据，我们整合了电厂运行记录、矿业公司收入数据及路线级交通传感器数据。通过利用电厂内部供应商煤矿降雨量的变异，我们发现降雨冲击降低了煤矿产出，并减少了燃煤电厂的可用性。每日交通数据证实，降雨减少了签约煤矿至电厂路线的煤炭交付量。这些中断向电网传播，加剧了轮流停电现象。电力安全不仅取决于电厂自身的韧性，还依赖于煤炭供应合同及物流的恢复能力。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为南非电厂与煤矿，数据与制度背景均非中国，明确不涉及中国研究。
title: Coal Supply Chains and Electricity Reliability
title_zh: 煤炭供应链与电力可靠性

abstract: Fertility has fallen in nearly all high-income countries. People also report wanting fewer children: between 2012 and 2022 the ideal number of children fell from 2.42 to 2.31 and the share of respondents intending a child within three years fell from 28 to 21 percent over a similar period. Why? Using two cross-national surveys that ask respondents about their attitudes and their fertility preferences, both fielded twice roughly a decade apart, we decompose each decline into the contribution of a broad and competing set of attitudes. Three stand out: children are increasingly seen as interfering with the freedom of parents; views on whether mothers of young children should work have become markedly more progressive and account for a substantially larger share of the decline among the tertiary-educated; and fewer people believe that women or men need children to lead a fulfilled life. This last attitude changed most over the decade and is the largest contributor to the fall in intended fertility, above all among less-educated women. The changing division of household work and increasing work-family conflict have minor contributions to changing fertility preferences.
abstract_zh: 几乎所有高收入国家的生育率均有所下降。人们也报告称希望生育更少的孩子：从2012年到2022年，理想子女数从2.42降至2.31，而在相近时期内，表示三年内有意生育孩子的受访者比例从28%降至21%。原因何在？利用两项跨国调查，这些调查询问受访者的态度和生育偏好，且每项调查均相隔约十年进行了两次，我们将每次下降分解为一系列广泛且相互竞争的态度所贡献的部分。其中三项态度尤为突出：孩子日益被视为妨碍父母自由；对于年幼孩子的母亲是否应工作的看法显著趋于进步，且在高等教育程度群体中，这一态度对下降的贡献占比明显更大；以及越来越少的人认为，无论男女，都需要孩子才能过上充实的生活。最后一种态度在十年间变化最大，并且是导致预期生育率下降的最大因素，尤其是在教育程度较低的女性中。家务分工的变化以及工作与家庭冲突的加剧，对生育偏好变化的影响较小。
title: Falling Fertility: The Changing Value of Freedom, Fulfillment, and Family
title_zh: 生育率下降：自由、成就与家庭价值的变迁

abstract: Social norms are an important barrier to gender convergence in economic outcomes. We study whether a public policy designed to promote gender equality at home can pave the way towards gender convergence by shaping gender norms in the next generation. We exploit the introduction of paid paternity leave in Spain in 2007, which granted fathers 13 days of non-transferable paid leave after childbirth. Eligibility depended sharply on the child’s date of birth. We combine this policy variation with original survey data collected from adolescents and implement a within-school difference-in-differences design comparing children born just before and after the reform cutoff within the same school cohort, using adjacent cohorts as controls. Children exposed to paternity leave eligibility display more egalitarian gender attitudes and beliefs in early adolescence. They are also more likely to engage in counter-stereotypical household chores, and hold less gender-stereotypical expectations regarding future work and family roles. The effects largely disappear in late adolescence.
abstract_zh: 社会规范是阻碍经济成果性别趋同的重要障碍。我们研究旨在促进家庭内部性别平等的公共政策，是否能够通过塑造下一代的性别规范，为性别趋同铺平道路。我们利用西班牙2007年引入的带薪陪产假政策，该政策赋予父亲在孩子出生后13天不可转让的带薪假期。资格严格取决于孩子的出生日期。我们将这一政策变化与从青少年中收集的原始调查数据相结合，实施校内双重差分设计，比较同一学校队列中在改革截止日期前后出生的儿童，并以相邻队列作为对照组。暴露于陪产假资格下的儿童在青春期早期表现出更平等的性别态度和信念。他们也更可能参与反刻板印象的家务劳动，并对未来的工作和家庭角色持有较少的性别刻板印象预期。这些影响在青春期后期基本消失。
title: Changing Gender Norms across Generations: Evidence from a Paternity Leave Reform
title_zh: 代际间性别规范的变迁：来自陪产假改革的证据

abstract: We study how subjective survival beliefs and financial literacy jointly shape saving and portfolio decisions later in life. Using data from the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing, we document that individuals who underestimate their survival probabilities are less likely to participate in risky financial markets. To identify the underlying mechanisms, we conduct a randomized survey experiment that cross-randomizes survival and financial literacy interventions and independently randomizes participation costs. Survival literacy updates subjective longevity beliefs, whereas financial literacy increases risky-asset participation by attenuating the deterrent effect of participation costs. We then build a heterogeneous-agent life-cycle model to evaluate survey-informed, revenue-neutral policy interventions. The counterfactuals show that financial literacy is the main driver of market entry, while survival literacy is complementary to financial literacy in raising the share of wealth invested in risky assets; only survival literacy, however, delivers positive welfare gains once financing costs are taken into account.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了主观生存信念与金融素养如何共同影响晚年储蓄及投资组合决策。利用英国老龄化纵向研究数据，我们发现低估自身生存概率的个体参与风险金融市场的可能性较低。为识别潜在机制，我们开展了一项随机调查实验，该实验交叉随机化生存干预与金融素养干预，并独立随机化参与成本。生存素养更新了主观寿命预期，而金融素养通过削弱参与成本的阻碍效应来提高风险资产参与度。随后，我们构建了一个异质性主体生命周期模型，以评估基于调查信息且收入中性的政策干预。反事实分析表明，金融素养是市场进入的主要驱动力，而生存素养在提高风险资产财富占比方面对金融素养具有互补作用；然而，仅生存素养在考虑融资成本后能带来正向福利收益。
title: Survival and Financial Literacy in Investment Decisions Later in Life
title_zh: 晚年投资决策中的生存与金融素养

abstract: Job mobility is risky, workers are risk averse, and insurance markets are incomplete. This paper studies how these features curb and distort job-to-job transitions by making workers excessively cautious: they place too much weight on job safety over wage and productivity gains. We demonstrate this tradeoff by eliciting employed workers’ wage-safety indifference curves in a custom, representative survey. On average, employed US workers require a 1.63% pay raise to accept each additional percentage point of annual unemployment risk in a new job. We assess the macroeconomic consequences of our mechanism by embedding it into a general equilibrium search model. Jobs differ in both wages (productivity) and unemployment risk, and risk-averse workers self-insure against unemployment risk through a non-state-contingent bond while searching on and off the job. We find that a complete markets counterfactual would boost job mobility by 12% and productivity by 0.19%. We also highlight a new role for unemployment insurance: it encourages employed workers to accept risky but high-productivity offers, thereby increasing productivity (by 1.3%) and job creation—as well as job loss and unemployment.
abstract_zh: 工作流动性具有风险，工人是风险规避的，且保险市场不完善。本文研究这些特征如何通过使工人过度谨慎来抑制和扭曲工作间转换：他们过分重视工作安全性，而忽视工资和生产率收益。我们通过一项定制、具有代表性的调查，引出在职工人的工资-安全性无差异曲线，从而展示这一权衡。平均而言，美国在职工人要求每增加一个百分点的新工作年度失业风险，需获得1.63%的加薪作为补偿。我们通过将该机制嵌入一般均衡搜索模型来评估其宏观经济后果。工作不仅在工资（生产率）上存在差异，也在失业风险上有所不同，风险规避的工人通过非状态依赖债券进行自我保险，同时在职或离职状态下进行搜索。我们发现，一个完全市场的反事实情景将使工作流动性提高12%，生产率提高0.19%。我们还强调了失业保险的新作用：它鼓励在职工人接受风险高但生产率高的职位，从而提高生产率（1.3%）和就业创造——同时也增加了失业和失业率。
title: Cautious Careers: Job Mobility under Incomplete Markets
title_zh: 谨慎的职业路径：不完全市场下的工作流动性

abstract: Protected areas play a central role in territorial governance and the provision of environmental public goods, yet their performance is typically evaluated through effectiveness-based frameworks rather than through efficiency analysis. This study provides a multidimensional assessment of 27 Italian National Parks, conceptualized as multi-mission public organizations operating within complex territorial and institutional contexts. Four mission-specific domains - ecological performance, tourism valorization, managerial administration, and governance capacity - are evaluated using Data Envelopment Analysis within a non-radial framework that captures asymmetric inefficiencies across functions. The analysis explicitly examines the role of institutional scale, distinguishing between pure technical inefficiency and structural scale effects. Results reveal differentiated performance regimes: ecological outcomes are largely anchored in territorial endowment, whereas tourism and managerial domains exhibit both slack-driven and scale-related inefficiencies. Governance performance appears strongly conditioned by the configuration of institutional scales. These findings highlight the importance of scale alignment and mission-specific benchmarking for improving the design and coordination of protected-area governance systems.
abstract_zh: 保护区在领土治理和环境公共产品供给中发挥着核心作用，然而其绩效通常通过基于有效性的框架而非效率分析来评估。本研究对27个意大利国家公园进行了多维度评估，将其概念化为在复杂领土和制度背景下运作的多使命公共组织。四个特定使命领域——生态绩效、旅游增值、管理行政和治理能力——采用数据包络分析在非径向框架内进行评估，该框架能够捕捉各功能间的非对称低效率。分析明确考察了制度规模的作用，区分了纯技术低效率与结构性规模效应。结果显示差异化的绩效模式：生态成果主要锚定于领土禀赋，而旅游和管理领域则表现出由松弛驱动和规模相关的双重低效率。治理绩效似乎受到制度规模配置的强烈制约。这些发现凸显了规模匹配和使命特定基准对于改善保护区治理体系设计与协调的重要性。
title: Multidimensional efficiency and institutional scale heterogeneity in protected areas: Evidence from Italy
title_zh: 保护区多维效率与制度规模异质性：来自意大利的证据

abstract: In this paper, we revisit the setup proposed in Nowak and Sigmund (1998) (NS (1998) henceforth) to study the evolution of social norms when individuals experience forms of indirect reciprocity based on the reputation of agents in the population. A result of the framework in NS (1998) is that cooperative behavior connected to the first-order assessment of reputations does not survive in the long run. Cooperators are always victims of a mutation in the population that favors free-riding. We extend the setup in NS (1998) studying the discrete-time dynamics of the evolution of social norms and introducing an additional form of social sanctioning: individuals who are naturally inclined to act pro-socially may act as enforcers (as in Sethi and Somanathan, 1996) and report free-riders to a third-party authority, which may impose a fine. We show, mainly numerically, that the conduct of enforcers, together with the presence of indirect reciprocity, allows for the existence of equilibria in which cooperation survives, and cooperative agents can co-exist with free-riders in the long run.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Nowak和Sigmund（1998）（以下简称NS（1998））提出的框架，用以研究当个体经历基于群体中代理人声誉的间接互惠形式时，社会规范的演化。NS（1998）框架的一个结果是，与一阶声誉评估相关的合作行为在长期中无法存续。合作者总是成为群体中偏好搭便车的突变的受害者。我们扩展了NS（1998）的设置，研究社会规范演化的离散时间动态，并引入一种额外的社会制裁形式：天生倾向于亲社会行为的个体可能充当执行者（如Sethi和Somanathan，1996），向第三方权威举报搭便车者，该权威可施加罚款。我们主要通过数值方法表明，执行者的行为，连同间接互惠的存在，使得合作得以存续的均衡得以存在，且合作者与搭便车者能够在长期中共存。
title: Discrete-time dynamics of indirect reciprocity: The role of punishment
title_zh: 间接互惠的离散时间动态：惩罚的作用

abstract: The political economy setting of voting over general nonlinear income taxes with labor disincentives and information asymmetry in consumer/worker/voter types is considered. Agents do not communicate or coordinate with each other. The economy is the realization of a finite draw from a continuous distribution. The revenue required from a draw is determined by Pareto optimal provision of a public good for that draw. Assuming that the government must meet the revenue requirement for any possible draw, in other words the tax is robust, a majority rule equilibrium is shown to exist at the median voter’s preferred tax function out of this robust set. The key restrictions on utility are additive separability, quasi-linearity, and that utility from the public good is multiplicative in type. JEL numbers: D72, D82, H21, H41 Keywords: Voting; Income taxation; Public good; Robustness
abstract_zh: 本文考虑了在一般非线性所得税上进行投票的政治经济环境，其中包含劳动抑制因素以及消费者/工人/选民类型的信息不对称。各主体之间不进行沟通或协调。经济状态是连续分布中有限次抽取的实现结果。每次抽取所需的财政收入由该抽取下公共物品的帕累托最优供给决定。假设政府必须满足任何可能抽取下的财政收入要求，即税收具有稳健性，则证明在多数规则均衡下，存在中位选民在该稳健集合中最偏好的税收函数。对效用的关键限制包括可加可分性、拟线性，以及公共物品效用与类型呈乘性关系。JEL分类号：D72, D82, H21, H41 关键词：投票；所得税；公共物品；稳健性
title: On the Political Economy of Nonlinear Income Taxation
title_zh: 论非线性所得税的政治经济学

abstract: China is the world’s second-largest economy, and its monetary policy can affect global demand and trade. Using granular mutual fund data, this column finds that country stock indices and firm-level stocks with greater exposure to Chinese mutual funds experience significantly lower returns than those with less exposure following contractionary Chinese monetary policy announcements. These responses can be explained by a portfolio rebalancing channel and appear to be driven by retail investors. Overall, the findings show that China’s private portfolio equity flows already exert an influence on global equity markets, and this channel is likely to strengthen in the future.
abstract_zh: 中国作为全球第二大经济体，其货币政策能够影响全球需求与贸易。利用细粒度共同基金数据，本专栏发现，在中国紧缩性货币政策公告后，相较于敞口较小的国家股指和公司层面股票，那些对中国共同基金敞口较大的股票指数及个股回报率显著更低。这些反应可通过投资组合再平衡渠道解释，且似乎主要由散户投资者驱动。总体而言，研究结果表明，中国的私人投资组合股权流动已对全球股票市场产生影响，且这一渠道未来可能进一步加强。
